newsitem.title: ITALY: Max rate 8.03 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.
newsitem.headline: Max rate 8.03 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.

text.p: The maximum rate at today's 4.0 trillion lire 15-day Bank of Italy reverse repurchase tender was 8.03 percent, compared with 8.05 at the previous reverse repo tender, the Bank said.
The average rate was also 8.03 percent against 8.02 percent at the last reverse repurchase pact for 5.0 trillion lire and five days on November 6.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for repurchase on November 26. The Bank said it received 38 bids of which two were met in full and three in part.
